name: outb
synopsis: void outb(unsigned char value, unsigned short port);
description: The outb function performs low-level output of a byte to a specified I/O port. It is primarily designed for internal kernel use but can be accessed from user space with proper permissions.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The byte value to output to the port

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port number to write to

return_value.failure: May result in segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not set

bugs: Requires compilation with optimization flags like -O or -O2, as functions are defined as inline macros; hardware-specific and may cause unresolved references without optimization.
